title: Raj Ayush UG/PG Counselling Board
raw_text: Raj Ayush UG/PG Counselling Board OFFICE OF CHAIRMAN, COUNSELING BOARD (UG/PG AYUSH Counseling Board, Govt. of Rajasthan) 212-214 AYUSH BHAWAN Sector-26 Pratap Nagar, Jaipur 302033 Toggle navigation Read Instructions Home Contact Us Counselling Information Our Gallery Welcome to Rajasthan Neet Ayush UG / PG Counselling Board - 2025 For Admission in AYUSH Under Graduate Courses viz. BAMS, BHMS BUMS & BNYS through NEET-2025 and AYUSH PG Courses (M.D./M.S.) (Ayurved) & M.D. (Homoeopathy) in AYUSH educational institutions in Rajasthan on state quota seats and NRI seats for the Session 2025-26, a State level Counseling Board has been constituted by the Government of Rajasthan under the Chairmanship of Dr. Batti Lal Bairwa, Additional Director, Department of Ayurveda, Govt of Rajasthan, Wide Order No. प. 25 (7) आयु./ 2023-1291 dated 26 July 2024. Aspirants will be required to get registered themselves for admission counseling for the Session 2025-26 in AYUSH colleges located in Rajasthan on the website of Counseling Board on the Dates as per Schedule after declaration of result of NEET-2025. Best Wishes Dr. Batti Lal Bairwa Chairman Latest News & Events Refer the notification(s), Information Booklet etc. before you start Locate Us © Rajasthan NEET Ayush Counseling Board.
